A hidden gem by West Lake
Jul 2026 • Family
One of the best dining experiences we’ve had in Hanoi. The wagyu teppan was cooked perfectly. Tender, flavorful, not overdone. And the fresh organic salad were a genuinely great match, not just a side thought. Loved the small details too, like the traditional hashioki chopstick rests, which added to the authentic Japanese feel of the place.

Cozy, calm atmosphere, attentive staff, and food quality that rivals what you’d pay far more for elsewhere. Highly recommend if you’re visiting Hanoi and want proper Japanese teppanyaki. Will definitely be back, when we visit Hanoi again.

A delightful Japanese dining experience
Dec 2025 • Friends
I had a wonderful experience at Japanese Teppan Salad Ann. The atmosphere is cozy and calm, perfect for a relaxed meal with friends or family. The teppan-style dishes were freshly prepared and full of flavor, with high-quality ingredients that you can really taste.

I especially enjoyed the salads, which were very fresh, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. The teppan dishes were cooked right, not too oily, and seasoned just enough to highlight the natural flavors. Portions were satisfying without being too heavy.

The staff were friendly, attentive, and welcoming, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Service was smooth and efficient, and they were happy to explain the menu.

Overall, this is a great place for anyone who enjoys Japanese food with a healthy and modern touch. I would definitely come back again.
